newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes up three cents at 14.48 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes up three cents at 14.48 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed three cents higher at 14.48 ringgit ($5.73) a kg aided by short-covering after Christmas despite an overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There was some covering from European, Japanese and local buyers, and not much pressure from sellers," said a trader.
Bids outnumbered offers by 80 tonnes to 71. Turnover was 70 tonnes against 95 on Tuesday. The local premium against London widened to $110 a tonne from $90 previously, traders said.
